decision_cruda.rationale: N600-08 stopped 5-8h, so LH-05 is idle. Norte has empty stockpile and trucks at 66 t/h with 0 inflow, so it is not truck-limited. RS-N522-03 has 412 t at 9.5 g/t and LH514 loads 38.5 t/h. Travel is 0.37 h plus 0.5 h activation, leaving about 5.6 loading hours, or about 217 t, which is about 66 oz. RS-N574-01 would give about 56 oz. RS-E543-02 is in Este, which is already truck-limited. Taking loaders from producing places is not allowed, and the development headings are worth more at home. No loans.
